data:
Microsoft's fiscal 2025 gross profit was larger than NVIDIA's, though it is close. These are figures from memory, not looked up in filings, so please verify them.

Microsoft (fiscal year ended June 30, 2025) reported revenue of about $281.7 billion and cost of revenue of about $87.8 billion, giving gross profit of roughly $193.9 billion. NVIDIA (fiscal year ended January 26, 2025) reported revenue of about $130.5 billion and gross profit of about $97.9 billion, a gross margin of roughly 75%. Microsoft's gross profit is therefore about 2.0 times NVIDIA's ($193.9B ÷ $97.9B ≈ 1.98). Note that the two fiscal years end at different times: NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 ended about five months before Microsoft's, so the periods are not perfectly aligned.
